# Codex Telegram Bridge v0.3.2

This release hardens recovery when the Codex app-server process or its PID record
becomes stale during a WSL restart.

- Reclaims stale app-server PID records with bounded reads, identity checks, and
  a lock held through the unlink operation.
- Uses private, no-follow directory and marker operations to protect recovery
  state from symlink and concurrent replacement races.
- Restarts the bridge after a managed-daemon app-server recovery, including
  resetting a bridge start-limit state so a recoverable outage does not require
  a manual WSL restart.
- Keeps installer start limits mode-specific and preserves the immutable release
  checksum contract for the version-pinned bootstrap.
